action.objective: Commit the verified Kh1, preserving king safety and avoiding the Bxf1/c3 tactics.
action.rationale: Kh1 is the only commit_ready move: exact -505 at effective depth 4, safety.complete with both mate-in-one and checking-chain probes not_found, and it was the broad-search suggestion. Rxd2 was bound=upper (-511, could be worse), and other rows are shallower or refuted by tactics like Bxf1. The kside pawn structure with h2/g3 is more resilient after Kh1.
